notes: One cob of 6. Assumptions: ~125 g kernels a cob (SA mielies are larger than the USDA medium ear of 102 g); USDA sweet corn values stand in for green mielies; chicken spice is about half salt. Compared against: a medium ear with 1 tbsp butter at 178-192 kcal (USDA-based estimates) and Hy-Vee grilled corn with 1 tbsp butter an ear at 240 kcal. Ours uses two-thirds of a tablespoon of butter a cob, so 180 kcal fits.
